title: [v0.92.1][TAIL-06.09][runtime] Repair greeting recovery identity and local-model boundary
goal: Repair the Runtime admission-greeting crash boundary, preserve one stable logical work identity across retries, and make the real-local Shepherd proof reject every off-host URL form.
required_outcome: Crash-safe bounded greeting recovery, immutable retry identity, and structural localhost-only URL validation with deterministic regressions.
acceptance_criteria: 1. A crash after the final permitted greeting-attempt claim cannot dispatch another attempt or corrupt durable load. 2. Admission, dispatch, provider work, result, transcript, and audit retain one immutable logical work key across retries. 3. Local Ollama proof rejects userinfo, off-host DNS, unsafe redirects, and authority-confusion forms. 4. Focused deterministic regressions pass at reviewed HEAD.
inputs: Issue #814; parent #522; internal review #520 findings D520-RUNTIME-001, D520-RUNTIME-002, D520-SEC-004; current Runtime control and Shepherd proof tests.
target_files_surfaces: adl-runtime-kernel/src/control.rs; adl-runtime/tests/shepherd_local_model.rs; tightly coupled Runtime tests only.
validation_plan: Run focused admission-greeting recovery tests, focused Shepherd local-model URL tests, Runtime owner validation lane, formatting, and diff hygiene.
demo_proof_requirements: Deterministic regression tests are the proof surface; no live cloud or provider execution is required.
non_goals: No provider-selection changes, Ollama deployment expansion, or general Runtime refactoring.
notes_risks: Recovery must remain fail-closed without making a valid max-attempt record unloadable; URL parsing must not accept alternate authorities or redirects.
